scope: Keep joined failures/uncertainty/cancellation authoritative when a bounded task also requests continuation
change: Shared jobs.IsContinuation accepts only wrapped/joined ErrContinue leaves and excludes explicit Retryable; Executor, periodic application wrapper and process-local observer reuse it.

detail: Executor cleared joined ordinary error/uncertainty/deadline/cancellation and finished yielded
Actual SQLite app/Store persisted yielded instead of retry_wait/unknown
Local observation counted pure continuation as failure

behavior: Pure/wrapped/pure-joined continuation -> Yielded and no local failure
Joined ordinary failure retains deterministic retry; explicit Retry(ErrContinue) retains retry
Joined unknown/deadline/context cancellation -> Unknown; explicit cancellation remains subject to durable Store request/token fence
Drain stops new local claims and waits for durable completion without canceling admitted handler
Process-local succeeded means this bounded invocation succeeded, not whole backlog complete
migration: None. No rewrite of past task states, financial facts, publication or accounting identities.
rollback: Code revert restores incorrect cleared outcomes. Previously incorrectly yielded work needs domain/external evidence; do not bulk mark it successful or reset/replay side effects.
remaining: Projection still uses bounded200-row batches and existing scheduler; no100ms dispatch or faster backlog guarantee
Independent worker and autoscaling not implemented
